blocks.text: 为 `@migaia/log-host` 增加 thinking/response 流式阶段。文本片段直接写入借用的 writer；结束阶段时另派发一条完整的结构化日志。
插件提供 `startThinking`、`thinking`、`endThinking`、`startResponse`、`response`、`endResponse` 六个方法。`write` 不增加 ANSI；未注入时借用已识别宿主的 stdout，无 stdout 时降级到 `console.log`。
完成条目的 tag 为 `thinking` 或 `response`，data 包含 `reasoningPhase` 与 `silent: true`。console 输出跳过 silent 条目，HTTP/file 仍可收到完整文本。插件不依赖 console 包，也不要求 host 提供 raw。
`asyncOutput` 默认 false；开启后流式写入与完成派发由 host 调度跟踪。writer 的同步异常进入 host 失败通道。卸载丢弃未完成缓冲，不自动生成完成条目。包与 host 的 peer 版本必须一致。
阶段规则与选项见 USEGUIDE.md。
安装 `@migaia/log-host` 与同版本的 `@migaia/log-plugin-reasoning`。`createLogHost({ plugins: [reasoningPlugin(options)] })` 推导六个阶段方法，不需要额外安装 level 或 console 插件。

rows: `startThinking(label?)`
进入 thinking；若正在 response，先完成它
`thinking(delta)`
原样追加片段；未处于 thinking 时自动开始
`endThinking()`
输出两个换行并完成当前 thinking
`startResponse(label?)`
进入 response；若正在 thinking，先完成它
`response(delta)`
原样追加片段；未处于 response 时自动开始
`endResponse()`
输出一个换行并完成当前 response

blocks.text: 显式再次开始同一阶段会重置该阶段的缓冲。空缓冲不生成完成条目。标签优先采用调用参数，其次 `labels.thinking` / `labels.response`；thinking 的默认标题是 `Thinking...`，response 默认无标题。标题输出后带两个换行，片段本身不增加换行或 ANSI。

`write(text): void` 是借用的同步能力，卸载不关闭它。未提供时，已识别的服务端宿主借用 `process.stdout.write`；没有 stdout 时使用 `globalThis.console?.log(text)`。`asyncOutput` 默认 false：流式写入立即发生，完成条目仍进入 host 异步日志管线。设为 true 时，流式写入与完成派发都通过 host 跟踪调度，`flush()` 可等待这些已接纳工作。

结束或切换阶段时，非空缓冲产生一条完整 message。thinking 的 tag/data.reasoningPhase 都为 `thinking`；response 的 tag 为 `response`，data.reasoningPhase 为 `responding`。两者均有 `data.silent: true`。console 插件跳过这些完成条目；HTTP/file 输出仍接收它们，便于保存完整文本。
`ReasoningPhase` 提供 `idle`、`thinking`、`responding` 三个稳定状态值。插件不依赖 console、不取得颜色能力，也不调用 host/core 的 raw。其它普通条目的格式仍由各输出端配置决定。
write 的同步异常以原错误进入 host 失败通道，不离开阶段方法。插件自身没有新增错误码，`LogReasoningErrorCode` 为空表。卸载后六个旧方法成为无操作，未完成缓冲被丢弃；不会自动派发未结束的段落。需要保留完整段落时先调用对应 end 方法，再等待 flush/shutdown。
Thinking and response streaming phases for `@migaia/log-host`. Fragments go directly to a borrowed writer. Completing a phase also dispatches one structured entry containing its full text.

The six methods are `startThinking`, `thinking`, `endThinking`, `startResponse`, `response` and `endResponse`. The writer receives text without plugin-generated ANSI. By default, a recognized server runtime lends its stdout; without stdout, output falls back to `console.log`.

Completed entries have a `thinking` or `response` tag and data containing `reasoningPhase` and `silent: true`. Console output skips these entries while HTTP/file outputs can retain the complete text. This module depends on no console module and requires no host raw method.

`asyncOutput` defaults to false. Enabling it schedules stream writes and completed-entry dispatch through the host. Synchronous writer failures enter the host failure channel. Uninstall discards unfinished text without publishing a completed entry. The module's peer version must match the host version.
See USEGUIDE.en.md for phase behavior and options.

Install matching versions of `@migaia/log-host` and `@migaia/log-plugin-reasoning`. `createLogHost({ plugins: [reasoningPlugin(options)] })` infers six phase methods without requiring a level or console plugin.

rows: `startThinking(label?)`
Enter thinking, first completing an active response
`thinking(delta)`
Append the original fragment, starting thinking automatically when needed
`endThinking()`
Write two newlines and complete the current thinking phase
`startResponse(label?)`
Enter response, first completing active thinking
`response(delta)`
Append the original fragment, starting response automatically when needed
`endResponse()`
Write one newline and complete the current response

blocks.text: Explicitly starting the same phase again resets its buffer. Empty buffers produce no completed entry. A call-level label takes precedence over `labels.thinking` / `labels.response`. Thinking defaults to `Thinking...`; response has no default heading. Headings end with two newlines. Fragments receive no extra newlines or ANSI.

`write(text): void` is a borrowed synchronous capability. Uninstall does not close it. Without an injected writer, recognized server runtimes lend `process.stdout.write`; without stdout, the fallback is `globalThis.console?.log(text)`. `asyncOutput` defaults to false: stream writes happen immediately while completed entries still enter the asynchronous host pipeline. When enabled, both writes and completed-entry dispatch use host-tracked scheduling. `flush()` waits for admitted work.

Ending or switching a nonempty phase publishes its full text as one message. Thinking uses `thinking` for both tag and data.reasoningPhase. Response uses the `response` tag and `responding` for data.reasoningPhase. Both set `data.silent: true`. The console plugin skips these entries. HTTP/file outputs still receive them for complete-text storage.

`ReasoningPhase` provides the stable values `idle`, `thinking` and `responding`. The plugin depends on no console module, acquires no color capability and calls no host/core raw method. Output format features still control other ordinary entries.

Synchronous writer failures reach the host failure channel with the original error and do not leave phase methods. The plugin introduces no error codes; `LogReasoningErrorCode` is empty. After uninstall, retained phase methods become no-ops. Unfinished text is discarded without publishing a completed entry. Call the relevant end method before flush/shutdown when the full phase must be retained.
